C0624.title: Jinhua Police Dismantle Consumer Voucher Cash-Out Ring, Seize 8.3 Million Yuan in Illegal Proceeds
C0624.summary: In June 2022, the Jinhua Public Security Bureau conducted a coordinated takedown across 19 cities in 12 provinces, dismantling 28 criminal groups involved in defrauding consumer vouchers. A total of 127 suspects were arrested and 8.3 million yuan in illegal proceeds were seized.
